module.purpose: Provides the ESM bundler-specific client configuration and helper functions for React Flight (Server Components) to resolve, preload, and require client/server references and collect debug info.
module.summary: This module implements the bundler ESM variant of the React Flight client config. It exposes functions to prepare module destinations, resolve client and server references into specifier/name pairs, preload modules via dynamic import with a promise cache, and synchronously require already-loaded modules. It also provides dev-only debug info gathering using performance resource timing and synthetic stack frames. The code bridges opaque client reference metadata to actual module URLs and enforces that server references live under a hosted root.
module.businessContext: Powers React Server Components client-side module loading for ESM bundlers. If it fails, client components cannot load, server references throw, and dev debugging breaks.
